## Santos have 12 players one booking from suspension for Palmeiras derby

Santos have 12 players one booking from suspension for the derby against Palmeiras on Wednesday at Vila Belmiro. [...] The match kicks off at 19:30 in the Brasileirão’s 33rd round. According to Diario Do Peixe, the list includes goalkeepers Gabriel Brazão, who is out for the season after shoulder surgery, and João Paulo.

## OneFootball Videos

Centre-back Lucas Veríssimo, who is recovering from a posterior thigh injury, and full-backs Escobar, who is being treated for thigh discomfort, and Gabriel Menino are also included.
